framing: EXPLORATORY (post-hoc-motivated). After the 2026-05-30 market-cap split-adjust correction, pure value is dead on free large-cap PIT data (value_EY +0.351 -> -0.098; value_profitability -0.109; quality_value_zsum collapsed to +0.004 once its value leg was de-contaminated). The ONLY confirmed directional survivors are the two CLEAN, mcap-free QUALITY signals: quality_roe_ttm (+0.242) and magic_formula (+0.093). This phase recombines exactly those into a single mcap-free quality composite to ask whether quality (not value) is the best-justified free-data directional bet. It is EXPLORATORY, not confirmatory: it recombines already-tested signals and is motivated post-hoc by the corrected results, so it cannot carry a confirmatory claim without an untouched holdout (e.g. S&P 600 OOS or a frozen future window). Reported as a point estimate + 90% CI alongside the existing family; PASS/FAIL is not the narrative.
contamination_note: All members are MCAP-FREE by construction (no price-denominated value leg), so this strategy is immune to the market-cap split-adjust bug (contamination_rerun_2026-05-30.md). ROE = TTM net income / stockholders equity; GP/A = TTM gross profit / total assets; magic_formula = rank-sum of (EBIT/assets) + (EBIT/(assets-cash)). No yfinance price enters any member -> no raw_prices dependence.

strategies.name: quality_composite_v1
strategies.rationale: Equal-weighted cross-sectional z-score sum of three mcap-free quality signals: ROE_ttm, gross-profitability (Novy-Marx 2013 GP/A), and the negated magic-formula rank-sum (Greenblatt EBIT/assets + ROIC). Recombines the only two corrected directional survivors (quality_roe +0.242, magic_formula +0.093) plus GP/A (the Novy-Marx quality anchor; standalone -0.095 but low-correlation to ROE). Requires >=2 of 3 signals present per ticker.
strategies.pre_registered_expectation: Does NOT pass the locked gate (excess_sharpe > 0.20 AND Holm-adj p < 0.05 AND 90% CI lower > 0). Framework MDE > +0.5 ExSharpe (Phase 0) means a ~0.15-0.30 quality composite lands in the Holm-killed band. This is the best-justified directional point-estimate bet on free data, not a confirmatory claim.

statistical_treatment.holm_scope: Standalone within-phase (N=1) for the headline point estimate + 90% CI. Also reported under joint Holm with the corrected Phase 1/3/4/7 family for context (NOT a new confirmatory family member - exploratory recombination of tested signals).

exclusions.reason: Same EDGAR-coverage constraint as Phase 3 (post-2009 XBRL mandate); 60-month train requires reliable fundamentals.

robustness_if_positive: Characteristic-shuffle placebo (randomly permute the composite score across tickers per date; CI must collapse to ~0)
Equal-weight vs each single member (ROE-only, GP/A-only, magic-only) to confirm the composite is not just one dominant leg
Leave-one-signal-out (drop each member, re-run) to confirm no single member drives the result
known_limitations: EXPLORATORY: recombines already-tested signals, motivated post-hoc by the corrected results. No confirmatory weight without an untouched holdout.
Quality_value_zsum (which included a value leg) is intentionally EXCLUDED - its corrected value leg contributed ~0, and any price-denominated leg re-introduces mcap-bug exposure.
Magic_formula uses total_assets as an EV proxy (Greenblatt approximation), not market EV - this is the clean, mcap-free formulation and is why magic_formula was unaffected by the contamination.
